description: Guards a form or working area against losing unsaved changes. Registers a router LocationChanging handler so internal navigation while dirty shows a TmDialog confirmation instead of navigating away silently, and optionally arms a browser beforeunload prompt for tab close/refresh. Does not manage locks or working copies itself — it only gates navigation.

parameters.name: IsDirty
parameters.description: Whether the host currently has unsaved work. Ignored when IsDirtyCallback is set.

parameters.name: IsDirtyCallback
parameters.description: Optional callback evaluated on every navigation check instead of IsDirty. Useful when dirty state is derived (e.g. from a working copy) rather than tracked as a simple flag.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: When false, the guard never blocks navigation or arms the browser unload prompt.

parameters.name: ConfirmTitle
parameters.description: Title shown in the leave-confirmation dialog.

parameters.name: ConfirmMessage
parameters.default: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.
parameters.description: Message shown in the leave-confirmation dialog.

parameters.name: ConfirmLeaveText
parameters.description: Text for the button that confirms leaving (discarding unsaved work).

parameters.name: CancelText
parameters.description: Text for the button that cancels navigation and stays on the page.

parameters.name: BeforeUnloadPrompt
parameters.description: When true, also registers a browser beforeunload prompt for tab close/refresh. The handler reads a client-cached dirty flag synchronously and never attempts a server call from inside unload.

parameters.name: OnConfirmLeave
parameters.description: Raised after the user confirms leaving, right before navigation is re-issued.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised after the user cancels and stays on the page.

parameters.name: OnSaveAndLeaveFailed
parameters.description: Raised after a failed OnSaveAndLeave closes the dialog (F10, DEC-SAVE-AND-LEAVE-FAILURE). The guard does not know what error surface the host has — no default focus target, no assumed toast — so the host wires this to move focus to its own error area or first invalid field and announce it (e.g. aria-live). Navigation stays cancelled and the blocked destination is cleared: leaving again requires a fresh navigation attempt. Focus timing: a synchronous element.focus() inside this callback races the dialog's focus-trap teardown (the trap restores returnTarget focus as the dialog unmounts, usually last) — move focus from OnAfterRenderAsync or after an await Task.Yield() so it lands after the trap's restore.

parameters.name: OnSaveAndLeave
parameters.description: Optional save callback. When set, the confirmation dialog gets a third "save and leave" button. Return true ONLY when the work is persisted: on true the guard re-issues the blocked navigation; on false it navigates nowhere, closes the dialog (see OnSaveAndLeaveFailed) and clears the blocked destination — a retry means the host triggers a fresh navigation attempt, not a second click in the same dialog. A thrown exception takes the same failure path (dialog closes, destination forgotten, OnSaveAndLeaveFailed fires) and then propagates to the host's error boundary. Before 2.8.16 this was an EventCallback and the guard left regardless of the outcome.

parameters.name: ShouldGuard
parameters.description: Optional predicate over the target URI deciding whether a navigation is guarded at all. Return false to let a navigation through without prompting even when the host is dirty (e.g. URL tabs of the same document). When null, every navigation is guarded.

parameters.name: SaveAndLeaveText
parameters.description: Text of the third button. Rendered only when OnSaveAndLeave is set.

examples.title: Guard a form with a working-copy dirty flag
examples.code:
<TmNavigationGuard IsDirty="@_isDirty"
                    OnConfirmLeave="@(() => _isDirty = false)" />

<EditForm Model="@_model" OnValidSubmit="Save">
    <TmTextInput @bind-Value="_model.Name" ValueChanged="@(v => { _model.Name = v; _isDirty = true; })" />
    <TmButton Type="ButtonType.Submit">Save</TmButton>
</EditForm>

examples.title: Suppress the guard for a post-commit programmatic navigation
examples.code:
<TmNavigationGuard @ref="_guard" IsDirty="@_isDirty" />

@code {
    private TmNavigationGuard? _guard;

    private async Task SaveAndCloseAsync()
    {
        await SaveAsync();
        _isDirty = false;
        _guard?.Suppress();
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/documents");
    }
}

examples.title: Custom confirmation text
examples.code:
<TmNavigationGuard IsDirty="@_isDirty"
                    ConfirmTitle="Discard changes?"
                    ConfirmMessage="Your edits have not been saved yet."
                    ConfirmLeaveText="Discard"
                    CancelText="Keep editing" />
